findings.finding: The plan authorized a broader generated-protocol tree and two nested gitlinks while the tracked implementation scope contains one protocol gitlink and generated *_pb2* outputs.
The RFC required generated .pyi distribution checks but did not authorize pyproject.toml to package those files.

The challenger reported a Node revision mismatch, but coordinator verification with git ls-tree HEAD sdks/nodejs confirms the parent tree pins 5faa0e000bf0dc9a6b4c14b4f2cbe095258ee91d. The RFC should state parent-tree evidence explicitly.

resolution: Narrow the plan and RFC to the tracked rapida/clients/protos/artifacts gitlink and generated *_pb2.py, *_pb2.pyi, and *_pb2_grpc.py outputs.
Authorize pyproject.toml package-data changes to ship generated .pyi files without changing the release version.
State that the parent repository tree pins Node.js at 5faa0e000bf0dc9a6b4c14b4f2cbe095258ee91d and preserve the exact git ls-tree command as evidence.
next_step: Revise the RFC and rerun the same independent challenger on the new exact bytes.
